overallWidth.notes: Square frame width; matched by native CAD optimal bounds.

overallHeight.notes: Square frame height; matched by native CAD optimal bounds.

overallDiagonal.notes: Circumscribed sharp-corner square envelope: sqrt(2) × 80.5. Rounded real corners are inside it. Ø95.5 in drawing is bolt circle, not frame diameter.

depth.location: Official shared DMA80-8 and -4 STEP, millimetres; native B-rep inspection
depth.notes: Complete CAD axial extent, -38.1 to +7.0 mm. Includes proud surround; not an installed rear projection.

packagingEnvelopeDepth.location: Official shared DMA80-8 and -4 STEP, millimetres; native B-rep inspection
packagingEnvelopeDepth.notes: Full CAD extent retained for conservative frontmost-plane screening; installed mounting datum still needs verification.

mountingFaceOffset.location: Official shared DMA80-8 and -4 STEP, millimetres; native B-rep inspection
mountingFaceOffset.notes: Display/screening datum at frontmost envelope plane, NOT a verified flange/gasket seat. Do not use this offset to place a manufactured driver.

cutoutDiameter.location: Official shared DMA80-8 and -4 STEP, millimetres; native B-rep inspection
cutoutDiameter.notes: Nominal circular passage surrogate chosen from CAD Ø75 feature (z=3.5 mm), conservatively above PDF 74.5 basket envelope. Not a tolerance-qualified baffle machining dimension.

drawingBasketDiameter.notes: Drawing rear basket outside width. No baffle machining tolerance provided.

drawingFlangeThickness.notes: Source callout; differs from some CAD axial features and is not used to infer seat position.

drawingRearDepth.notes: Source side-view callout retained without forcing a common PDF/CAD mounting datum.

drawingBoltHoleDiameter.notes: PDF says 4 × Ø3.8; CAD holes are Ø4.0. Automatic drill guides withheld.

drawingBoltStartAngle.notes: Symmetric square hole pattern; centers ±95.5/(2 sqrt(2)).

cadBoltHoleDiameter.location: Official shared DMA80-8 and -4 STEP, millimetres; native B-rep inspection
cadBoltHoleDiameter.notes: Native STEP circular edges radius 2 mm at each corner; conflicts with drawing Ø3.8.

cadBoltCenterOffsetX.location: Official shared DMA80-8 and -4 STEP, millimetres; native B-rep inspection
cadBoltCenterOffsetX.notes: Native STEP corner hole centers at x=±33.75 mm.

cadBoltCenterOffsetY.location: Official shared DMA80-8 and -4 STEP, millimetres; native B-rep inspection
cadBoltCenterOffsetY.notes: Native STEP corner hole centers at y=±33.75 mm.

boltCircleDiameter.notes: PDF 95.5 versus CAD 95.4594; source-reference values retained separately.

boltHoleDiameter.notes: PDF Ø3.8 versus CAD Ø4.0; measure the physical variant before drilling.

boltCount.notes: Count agrees across drawing and CAD; final drill geometry withheld.

effectivePistonArea.notes: Manufacturer Sd; do not confuse with chassis cutout area.

geometry.datum: frontmost conservative envelope plane z=0; positive z rearward; actual mounting-seat offset unresolved

parts.name: Conservative complete driver envelope
parts.notes: Sharp-square circumscribed cylinder with complete native CAD axial extent. No diaphragm, mounting seat, hole or exact physical body is implied.
